_README: Search-engine and platform ownership tokens. Every value here is PUBLIC by
design: its whole job is to be fetched by the platform to prove the same
person controls this domain and that account. Nothing here is a secret and
nothing here grants access to anything.
Empty string means 'not verified yet'. build_seo.py emits a tag only for a
key with a non-empty value, so an unfilled file changes no byte of the site.
HOW TO FILL IT IN: see OWNER-ACTIONS.md, item 'Search Console verification'.
then deploy. Then press Verify in the platform's UI.
